title_en: At the New Market, 2+1 Apartment for Sale, Totally Restored, Ideal for Investment!!!
description_en: Super Apartment 2+1 with perfect location for sale at the New Market!!! The apartment is located on the 4th floor of a new building with a net area of ​​71 m2 and a gross area of ​​78.2 m2 and is organized in a spacious corridor that distributes it to other rooms, starting with the living room together with the kitchen area and exit to the balcony, two rooms, a toilet. The environment has recently been invested: parquet flooring, plumbing and electrical installations, doors, windows, etc. The orientation is from the East, which means that there is natural light throughout the day. The area where it is located is quite preferred both for residence and for investment, being very close to the center and the rental values ​​in this area are high. It has every possible facility such as nurseries, kindergartens, schools and any other service. The apartment has regular mortgage documentation.
